description: Labelled evaluation set for LexiQuery. `expected_docs` are the documents that genuinely answer the question; `must_include` are keywords a correct answer has to contain; `out_of_scope` questions must be refused.

questions.question: What is the standard canary rollout schedule for a production release?
How do I roll back a bad release and how fast should it be?
How quickly must a Sev1 incident be acknowledged?
When do we escalate an incident to the director of engineering?
What are the rate limits for the Pro tier of the public API?
Which headers does the API return when a client is rate limited?
How long are audit logs retained?
How long do we have to complete a customer data deletion request?
How often must database credentials be rotated?
What is the patching deadline for a critical vulnerability?
What does the RDS-4471 error mean and how do I fix it?
How long does a PostgreSQL failover take and what happens to the old primary?
Should containers set CPU limits in Kubernetes?
Why must a liveness probe not check a downstream dependency?
What compensation applies when an engineer is paged in the middle of the night?
What happens when a service exhausts its error budget?
How long is a deprecated API version supported after the notice?
Is adding a new optional response field a breaking change?
What is the policy for untagged cloud resources?
What do we do with a flaky test?
How is latency reported on dashboards and why not an average?
Can I deploy to production on a Friday?

out_of_scope: What is the capital city of France?
Who won the football world cup in 1998?
What is the recipe for a Neapolitan pizza dough?
How do I fix the carburettor on a 1972 motorcycle?
paraphrase_description: Questions deliberately written with little lexical overlap with the source document - this is where BM25 alone degrades and dense retrieval earns its place.

paraphrase_questions.question: If a shipped change is hurting customers, what is the fastest way to undo it?
Who do I wake up when a total outage is still not fixed after an hour?
What stops one greedy workload from eating all the RAM on a shared machine?
How much warning do customers get before an old endpoint disappears?
What does someone get back if their sleep was interrupted by alerts?
How do we make sure an unused machine is not silently burning money?
